notes: Filed issue #6 in `.gator/issues.md` for the `migrate_layout()` Step 5 directory-conflict bug discovered while helping the Architect update the `code/donoriq` fleet repo.
Sibling to the file-conflict bug that v2.5.3 fixed. Step 5's merge loop handles files correctly but has no branch for the both-directories-exist case:

No `else` branch when `dest_f.exists()`. So `.gator/scripts/__pycache__/` (present at src) with `.gator/.includes/scripts/__pycache__/` (present at dest) leaves both in place, `rmdir` fails, layout re-detects mixed, migration never converges.

Any repo where `.gator/scripts/` accumulated `__pycache__/` (Python bytecode from running scripts) or `hooks/` (legacy pre-monorepo hook wrapper location) will hit this. `code/donoriq` was example #1. Likely other fleet repos affected — the `__pycache__` case triggers on any Python invocation under `.gator/scripts/`.
